enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up to chest. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow under head. Move right arm under pillow. Sleep. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Pull blanket down slightly. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Sleep. Move left arm. Adjust blanket. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and getting out of bed
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Yawn. Stretch arms above head. Sit up. Swing legs over edge of bed. Stand up. Walk to fan. Press button to turn off fan. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth, using toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Lift toilet seat. Urinate. Flush toilet. Lower toilet seat. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, bread, milk. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Turn on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Remove toast. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Wash dishes. Turn off light. Exit kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Close closet. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Check phone. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Stop at corner. Check phone for time. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Place bag on lap. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator at a nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Enter office. Greet colleague. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Attend meeting. Sit in chair. Listen to speaker. Take notes. Speak to group. Return to desk. Make phone call. Type report. Print document. File document.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Stand in line. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Throw away trash. Return tray. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator at a nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open files. Type document. Attend meeting. Take notes. Make phone calls. Reply to emails. Organize papers. Use printer. Discuss with colleague. Return to desk. Type report. Save file. Shut down computer.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Place bag on lap. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to home. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Serve onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Wash dishes. Turn off light. Exit kitchen.

Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put down phone. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Return to sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer for leisure or planning
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Log in. Open browser. Check emails. Browse websites. Open planning document. Type notes. Check calendar. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Walk to bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene: showering and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust shower temperature. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Hang towel. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.
Enter bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Sleep. Turn to side. Move arm. Sleep.
